content: Feature delivery follows requirements -> map_check -> implementation -> candidate -> validation -> review -> integration -> cleanup. architecture, map_update, effectiveness, and promotion are explicit advisory bypasses selected by scope and risk; a bypass is recorded rather than silently omitted.
title: Feature delivery spine

content: Debug work follows orient -> explore -> resolve -> candidate -> validation -> review -> integration -> cleanup. orient reads the declared maps, notes, records, and gates; explore records reproduction and causal evidence; resolve changes the mapped unique owner and updates maps or gates when the verified contract changes.
title: Debug delivery spine

content: For runtime or framework work, inspect resource map first, then function map, mainline call map, module registry, verification map, and source. Bind the issue to one owner and adjacent edges before editing; map gaps are recorded and repaired through the owning map scope instead of being inferred from grep results.
title: Architecture binding order

content: The implemented TUI path is plugin startup/CLI -> Cordis startup composition -> terminal input/app-event-bus/logic-controls/app-shell -> TuiSessionService -> AgentHost/AgentRemote adaptor -> session normalizer -> TuiPresentationService -> interpreter/text-parser/tool-card/theme -> TuiDisplayBufferService -> TuiTerminalRenderService -> TuiTerminalUiService -> TuiTerminalLifecycle/Ink -> terminal. Presentation and downstream rendering do not consume agent-specific raw protocol.
title: TUI event-to-terminal path

content: The current adaptor control path is terminal/input logic -> TuiSessionService -> AgentHost/AgentRemote -> concrete agent client -> session/event contract. The adaptor owns protocol translation and control operations; the TUI presentation and render chain consumes the normalized contract rather than reconstructing provider state.
title: Agent control path

content: A task closes only after affected validation, required build/install/restart/online evidence, review, integration, remote receipt when delivery is in scope, and final owner worktree cleanup. The owner re-reads project rules, local Skills, and MEMORY before promoting only verified reusable facts.
title: Closeout path
